query: SELECT membership.user_id FROM team_user membership JOIN "User" profile ON profile.id=membership.user_id WHERE membership.team_id=$1 AND membership.user_id=$2 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM password_team_lifecycle closed WHERE closed.team_id=membership.team_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM password_account_lifecycle closed WHERE closed.account_id=profile.macro_user_id) FOR KEY SHARE OF membership
